title: Prove single crossing for every fixed p16 fragmentation invoice
body:
This enabling proof removes the grid-only single-crossing assumption S1 for every positive-integer fragmentation invoice in the fixed p16 controller class. The complete moment is strictly increasing on `t in [4/5,1]` and has exactly one zero with `C=1-t in (0,1/20)`. This makes the class's raw-moment sufficiency test rigorous. It produces no new native word or κ improvement.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b0edd31a04fe4705846df7673b4a0ec2442260d0/research/fragmentation-single-crossing/PROOF.md), [certificate receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b0edd31a04fe4705846df7673b4a0ec2442260d0/research/fragmentation-single-crossing/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b0edd31a04fe4705846df7673b4a0ec2442260d0/research/fragmentation-single-crossing/SOURCES.json) and [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b0edd31a04fe4705846df7673b4a0ec2442260d0/research/fragmentation-single-crossing/verify.py). Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority 7.

Fix p=16, a=7 or 8, v=112, d=8, 18 native calls, the retained 408 helper endpoints and eight rank-8 center jobs per call. Each main/helper net increment may be split into any positive integer partition of that increment. Helper targets stay fixed; only their paid increments are partitioned. Keep all other targets and paid jobs fixed. Partitions may differ across fields and calls; no realizable native word is asserted for each partition. Descents, nonnested excess cost, extra jobs, changed endpoints and coded interfaces are outside the theorem.

The key certificate uses weighted tails `B_k=sum_(r>=k) r(T_r-P_r)`. Splitting a paid rank cannot decrease any tail. The unsplit comparison has B_k=2432 for k=2,...,8 and B_k>=32480 for k=9,...,145. Summation by parts proves strict interval monotonicity. Exact integer-power enclosures give:

```text
f_unsplit(19/20) <= -1994616351/524288 < -3804
f_partition(19/20) <= f_unsplit(19/20)
f_partition(1) = 752.
```

Thus every invoice in the class has one crossing. The proof replaces sampling; it does not add more digits to the existing root.

Use CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fragmentation-single-crossing
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/fragmentation-single-crossing
```

Both registered modes passed under Python 3.12.13 with warnings as errors and `-O`. Expected verifier marker: `PASS_FRAGMENTATION_SINGLE_CROSSING`. Checks bind the complete source invoice, all 144 tails, 96 positive integer partitions, 22 exact root intervals and a rational exponential bound. Changed high-rank cost, missing helper credit and a wrong partition total are controls. Committed-byte/export checks, both direct exported modes and `git diff --check` passed. Full-history validation was not run in the shallow checkout. No native, Lean, compiler, outer-ledger or selected replay ran.

[PR #5226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5226) supplies the fragmentation framework and [S1 statement](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/fragmentation-ceiling/PROOF.md). Its [source attribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/fragmentation-ceiling/README.md) names Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code; no human authorship is inferred from the submission account. Cao Yifan (@intqwq) supplies [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610) and the [consumed invoice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/ARITHMETIC.json). Retained controller/native credit is preserved. New proof and checks: Ali Romman (@aliromman) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; author-checked, not independent acceptance. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19151239).
